# Shopware Storefront — JavaScript plugins, selectors and events

Every Storefront behaviour is a plugin class bound to a selector. `PluginManager` scans the DOM after load, instantiates each plugin on every matching element, and re-runs the scan when markup is replaced by AJAX.

**70 registrations, 74 plugin classes, 111 distinct published events.**

## Contents

- [Keeping a plugin alive through a template change](#keeping-a-plugin-alive-through-a-template-change)
- [Registrations](#registrations)
- [Plugin options](#plugin-options)
- [Published events](#published-events)
- [Data attributes in templates](#data-attributes-in-templates)

## Keeping a plugin alive through a template change

The selector is the contract between markup and behaviour. Keep the attribute on the element when you restructure a template, and keep the child selectors the plugin's options name — those default to class or attribute lookups inside the plugin's own element.

Override a plugin with `PluginManager.override('Name', MyClass, selector)` to replace it, or `extend` to inherit and change part of it. Registering a second plugin on the same selector is fine; both run.
